description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口**CreateSharePromotionActivity**返回的**Data**值。
description.en:
The ID of the promotional activity.  

This value is returned in the **Data** field of the response from the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** API.

description.zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见[使用共享设备播报分享语料](~~607661~~)。
description.en:
The share code of the sharing job.  

For information about the share code of a sharing job, see [Use shared devices to broadcast shared audio content](~~607661~~).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
促销活动使用的详细说明，请参见**CreateSharePromotionActivity**接口文档的**使用说明**。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
For detailed instructions on using promotional activities, see the **How-To** section in the documentation for the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** API.  

## queries per second (QPS) Limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 20 per Alibaba Cloud account.  

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.
